title: Adrián Moreno Peña (VP Technology, Worksome) — Incorruptible as the guide to stop a company you built with Lean Startup from rotting into what you never wanted
summary: Worksome VP of Technology Adrián Moreno Peña (ex-SumUp) frames Incorruptible as the natural sequel to The Lean Startup — 'the same person that taught so many people how to validate an idea and turn it into a business brings now the guide on how to not let that company rot and evolve into what you never wanted it to be.' Pulls Eric's redefinition of profit: 'the maximization of human flourishing.'
blockquote: I find poetic that the same person that taught so many people how to validate an idea and turn it into a business (with The Lean Startup) brings now the guide on how to not let that company rot and evolve into what you never wanted it to be.
attribution_title: VP of Technology, Worksome · former VP of Engineering, SumUp · Copenhagen
